title: Holiday Card Send Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holiday:card
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by card_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when holiday card send data has stopped arriving for a given card type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per card type and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your holiday card send feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
